limits: Explicit persistent session lifecycle; exit0 does not assert uninterrupted frame rate or physical headset acceptance.

xr_preflight.evidence: strict focused source0 CSV and required startup panel

camera_ready.evidence: before_native_activation callback returned and startup remained live

native_prepare.evidence: native preparation command exited 0; does not prove a stereo frame

native_running.evidence: fresh running status with matching owner; does not prove a stereo frame

first_stereo_submission.evidence: XR epoch1 actual projection successful xrEndFrame marker

rate_definitions.game_present_calls_per_second: Top-level bound game DXGI Present observations, excluding TEST calls; not engine-update or displayed FPS.
rate_definitions.stereo_pairs_per_second: New native stereo image publications; separate from repeated XR submissions.
rate_definitions.xr_loop_hz: CSV frame delta / runtime predicted-display-time delta; not verified projection or physical display FPS.
rate_definitions.missing: null means unavailable, first sample, stale sample, changed identity or reset; it does not mean zero FPS.
